title: Wonderful Hike! Would do again!
text: Antoine, our guide was knowledgeable and a wonderful guide. The conversation was easy flowing and my husband and I loved our experience! Would definitely consider an even longer hike if offered. So much local history and engagement with locals. He is also clearly well respected among with locals of whom he has established relationships and extend to the enrichment of his guests. Thanks!

author: Chean831

title: Great trip with our guide, Craig
text: My wife and I had a wonderful Costa Brava trip with our guide, Craig.  We enjoyed Craig's commentary along the drive and his selection of scenic stops.  The hike along the coast was easy and beautiful, I'm 72 and had no trouble with it.  We had a delicious lunch and tour of Costa Brava.  Would take this trip again in a heartbeat.
author: H618KWdavidf

title: Perfect tour of Costa Brava & Medieval Girona
text: This was an excellent English language small group tour with Craig as our guide.  He spoke perfect English.  From the moment we got in the van we started asking questions about local history, economy and geography details.  Craig's depth of knowledge and the way he provided the information was thorough and entertaining.  The ride to Costa Brava and Girona went by quickly and we all learned so much.  The sites and views you will see are once in a lifetime!  With Craig's help not a moment was wasted.  Lunch was local and wonderful.  You will be delighted if you take this tour.
author: AZMom2022
